properties.name: The unused Anchor node type is removed, as 0.85.0 announced: the first item taken off the served surface
properties.rationale: The removing half of dec:anchor-retire-or-implement under cap:a-served-item-is-removed-only-after-a-release-that-announced-it: 0.85.0 announced it (describe_schema mark, deprecation_notice, CHANGELOG ### Deprecated with What to do), and this release removes it, on Anthony's word 2026-10-17 ("Remove it before the tag"). The v0.86.0 cut had first kept it; the served mark then read "DEPRECATED in 0.85.0, removed in the next release" in the release that did not remove it. MEASURED with stores the published 0.85.0 binary wrote (sha256 of its tarball d8eb4c65…, matching checksums.txt) and this build: a store holding no Anchor opens; a store holding one is refused naming it ("THE GRAPH ACTUALLY HOLDS Anchor"); an export holding one is refused by the import, all or nothing, nothing written; deleting the Anchor with 0.85.0 and then opening with 0.86.0 works; 0.85.0 still opens a store 0.86.0 opened (warning it is behind). Matches fact:what-removing-the-anchor-type-does-to-a-graph-that-holds-one-measured-2026-10-14, including its point (3): the open refusal's recipe contradicted the import, now corrected. #753's rule: Alex is owed a note before the tag; drafted for Anthony. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Anchor leaves the schema (29 -> 28 node types) and its deprecation registry entry leaves with it, so the registry is empty and no served text carries a deprecation mark. narrowing::NARROWINGS gains {NodeType Anchor, Retired, dec:anchor-retire-or-implement, 2026-10-17}; schema/accepted-at-last-release.json is re-blessed as 0.86.0's without Anchor; the MCP surface record is re-blessed from the published 0.85.0 binary, whose describe_schema announced the removal. The provenance refusal's recipe no longer says a retired type "is dropped and named on import" (false: the import refuses it whole) and gives the measured way through; the import's refusal names a retired type as retired with its decision; the open note on a store naming a retired type it holds none of says so instead of "additive only". The test the_unused_anchor_type_is_announced_for_removal.rs is replaced by the_unused_anchor_type_is_removed.rs.
